mapper.sql: select s.ranking_id, s.ranking_type, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.work_id, s.rank_no, s.score, s.view_count, s.bookshelf_count, s.growth_score, s.snapshot_time, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, w.title as work_title from sys_ranking_snapshot s left join sys_work w on w.work_id = s.work_id
mapper.update: update sys_ranking_snapshot set rank_no = #{rankNo}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where ranking_id = #{rankingId}
mapper.select: select work_id, view_count from sys_work where is_deleted = 0
select work_id, count(*) as bookshelf_count from sys_subscribe group by work_id
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_ranking_snapshot (ranking_type, period_start, period_end, work_id, rank_no, score, view_count, bookshelf_count, growth_score, snapshot_time, status, create_by, create_time) values
(#{item.rankingType}, #{item.periodStart}, #{item.periodEnd}, #{item.workId}, #{item.rankNo}, #{item.score}, #{item.viewCount}, #{item.bookshelfCount}, #{item.growthScore}, #{item.snapshotTime}, #{item.status}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
